Fort Joy

Fort Joy is the island prison where Emberfall starts. You wake on the beach below the keep. Treasure is hidden in the beach caves, the ghetto and the cellars under the keep; most chests need a lockpick or a shovel. The wiki has no treasure map of Fort Joy yet.
